note: Clay County TX publishes no queryable zoning district service. The county's only zoning material is a PDF ('Zoning & Building Permits - Unincorporated Areas') and no county zoning layer appears in ArcGIS Online/Hub searches. The Henrietta zoning map is a vendor viewer (Zoninghub) with no public REST service found. The StoryMap that matched 'Clay County zoning' (AG, ASC, HC districts) belongs to Clay County, Minnesota (map.claycountymn.gov), not Texas. Other incorporated cities (Bellevue, Byers, Petrolia) publish no zoning GIS found.
